rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the source is internally consistent. The schedule total fair value is $230,281,379 and the balance-sheet net-assets proxy (Total Members' Capital) is $213,530,000, so investments equal 107.845% of net assets and correctly round to the filing's 108.0%. The same one-decimal convention is visible at the position level: Fenix fair value $5,754,396 divided by $213,530,000 is 2.695%, printed as 2.7%. The 25.49% identity failure rate therefore reflects a check/anchor precision mismatch against filer-rounded percentages, not erroneous extracted source values. No row-level source-artifact violations were supplied, so no culprit is localized.
